Limit the number of objects to return from the collection that is fed into the map reduce operation Often used in
conjunction with a query and sort option so as to reduce the portion of the data that will be processed.
items.translation: 限制从输入到 MapReduce 操作的集合中返回的对象数量。通常与查询和排序选项结合使用，以减少需要处理的数据量。

items.source: The output will be inserted into a collection which will atomically replace any existing collection with the same name. Note, the default is MapReduceAction.REPLACE.

items.source: With this option, no collection will be created, and the whole map-reduce operation will happen in RAM.
items.translation: 选择此选项时，不会创建任何集合，整个 MapReduce 操作将在内存中完成。

items.source: This option will merge new data into the old output collection.
items.translation: 此选项将把新数据合并到旧输出集合中。

items.source:
If documents exists for a given key in the result set and in the old collection, then a reduce operation (using the
specified reduce function) will be performed on the two values and the result will be written to the output
collection.
items.translation: 如果结果集和旧集合中均存在给定键对应的文档，则会对这两个值执行归约操作（使用指定的归约函数），并将结果写入输出集合。

items.source:

name.
items.translation: 该输出将插入到集合中，并原子性地替换任何具有相同名称的现有集合。

items.source:
Flag that toggles behavior in the map-reduce operation so as to avoid intermediate conversion to BSON between the
map and reduce steps.
items.translation: 用于在 MapReduce 操作中切换行为的标志，以避免在 Map 和 Reduce 步骤之间进行中间 BSON 转换。

items.source: The collection where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的集合。

items.source: The database where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的数据库。

items.source:
The collection where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored. Note, you can set the database name
as well with the outputDatabase option.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的集合。请注意，您也可以通过 outputDatabase 选项设置数据库名称。

items.source:
The database where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored. Note, you ca set the collection name
as well with the outputCollection option.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的数据库。请注意，您也可以通过 outputCollection 选项设置集合名称。

items.source:
With this option, no collection will be created, and the whole map-reduce operation will happen in RAM. Also, the
results of the map-reduce will be returned within the result object. Note that this option is possible only when
the result set fits within the 16MB limit of a single document.
items.translation: 使用此选项时，不会创建任何集合，整个 MapReduce 操作将在内存中完成。此外，MapReduce 的结果将直接返回到结果对象中。请注意，仅当结果集大小不超过单个文档的 16MB 限制时，才可使用此选项。

items.source:
This option will merge new data into the old output collection. In other words, if the same key exists in both the
result set and the old collection, the new key will overwrite the old one.
items.translation: 此选项会将新数据合并到旧输出集合中。换句话说，如果结果集和旧集合中存在相同的键，新键将覆盖旧键。

items.source:
If documents exists for a given key in the result set and in the old collection, then a reduce operation (using the
specified reduce function) will be performed on the two values and the result will be written to the output
collection. If a finalize function was provided, this will be run after the reduce as well.
items.translation: 如果结果集和旧集合中均存在给定键的文档，则会对这两个值执行归约操作（使用指定的归约函数），并将结果写入输出集合。如果提供了最终化函数，该函数将在归约之后运行。

items.source:
Flag that toggles behavior in the map-reduce operation so as to avoid intermediate conversion to BSON between the
map and reduce steps. For MongoDB 1.9+
items.translation: 用于在 MapReduce 操作中切换行为的标志，以避免在 Map 和 Reduce 步骤之间进行中间 BSON 转换。适用于 MongoDB 1.9+ 版本。

items.source: limit - Limit the number of objects to process
items.translation: limit - 限制要处理的对象数量

items.source: collectionName - The name of the collection where the results of the map-reduce operation will be stored.

items.source: outputDatabase - The name of the database where the results of the map-reduce operation will be stored.

items.source: finalizeFunction - The finalize function. Can be a JSON string or a Spring Resource URL
items.translation: finalizeFunction - 最终化函数。可以是 JSON 字符串或 Spring 资源 URL。

items.source: scopeVariables - variables that can be accessed from map, reduce, and finalize scripts
items.translation: scopeVariables - 可从 map、reduce 和 finalize 脚本中访问的变量。

items.source: javaScriptMode - if true, have the execution of map-reduce stay in JavaScript
items.translation: javaScriptMode - 如果为 true，则让 MapReduce 的执行保持在 JavaScript 中。

items.translation: collation - 可以为 NULL。
